ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of low-intensity (dark pigment) to high-intensity (white mottling) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distinct white mottling and light-grey speckling concentrated on the distal (outer) thirds of both lobes, while the medial area near the notch is primarily solid dark pigment.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central notch with an approximate pixel angle of 52 degrees and a depth ratio significant to the overall fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge with irregular pixel-amplitude peaks, particularly prominent on the inner half of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curvature extending from the median notch to the high-contrast distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity circular pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated heavily on the leading edge and distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint horizontal to diagonal linear pixel disruptions (likely rake marks) visible on the medial-to-lateral section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle colonization and associated scarring on the distal leading edges; irregular notch on the right lobe trailing edge likely representing physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density clusters of acorn barnacles on the extreme lateral tips provide a unique, highly textured geometric profile.
